438:t_021:4.en:
$n
「And I'll definitely rescue Miss $$スズネ$$, who gave me my final strength!」

438:t_022:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like you got past $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s shadow and opened the final door, too.」

438:t_023:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$太極$$... Come to think of it, the philosophy of Jeet Kune Do is...)

438:t_023:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Dangerous...! The Age of the Sun is nearly upon us!」

438:t_023:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Did you see that, $$ゲシュタルト$$! This is the power of us... of $c!」

438:t_023:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The army of darkness, the other Miss $$スズネ$$, $$バアル$$, the whole lot of them, I'll take care of them all!!」

438:t_024:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is... the consciousness of people, linked by GN Particles, is lending each other strength...!」

438:t_024:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「The light in people's hearts... That is what lights the way.」

438:t_024:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We can't afford to lose, neither us nor humanity.」

438:t_024:6.en:
$n
(The moment $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ was born... I felt everything...)

438:t_024:7.en:
$n
(Everything in this world... has a heart... And that becomes my strength... our strength...)

438:t_024:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$ and $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$! I will make all of that power mine!」

438:t_024:9.en:
$n
「Light and darkness, hope and despair... Beyond them lies the place I'm meant to go...!」

438:t_024:10.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I'm coming to get you now!!」

438:t_025:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Confirming the end of combat.」

438:t_025:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So we can rest easy, for now.」

438:t_026:1.en:
$n
「No, not yet. I can't celebrate until we've rescued Miss $$スズネ$$ and taken back the Earth.」

438:t_026:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Aiming high is a good thing.」

438:t_026:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Well then... let's head back and give AG and $$クロウ$$ what for.」

438:t_026:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Naturally. It turned out well, but it was far too dangerous a gamble.」

438:t_026:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$クロウ$$ and AG are both scared of Dr. $$トライア$$, so how about we tattle?」

438:t_026:8.en:
$n
「It's all right, $$クロウ$$. I'll speak up for you.」

438:t_026:10.en:
$n
「I'm grateful, after all, to both $$クロウ$$ and AG.」

438:t_026:11.en:
$n
「And of course, I want to thank everyone too.」

438:t_026:14.en:
$n
(And someday... I'll thank Miss $$スズネ$$ too.)

438:t_026:15.en:
$n
(For all that's happened, for today... and for the future...)

438:t_027:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I have seen your power.」

438:t_027:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wait, $$ゲシュタルト$$! What are you fighting for!?」

438:t_027:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Isn't it obvious? For the sake of this universe.」

438:t_027:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Until we meet again, $c. Next time, I shall appear together with my friend, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.」

438:t_028:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! I never want to see your face again!」

438:t_028:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$タケル$$... What $$ゲシュタルト$$ said about doing it for the universe...」

438:t_028:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Maybe they, too, are trying to use the Earth's power to fight $$バアル$$...」

438:t_029:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I've seen it, the power of $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$.」

438:t_029:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$n... You may believe you've overcome despair, but the wounds from your mother still remain inside you.」

438:t_029:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「They will swallow you with ease. Can you resist?」

438:t_029:5.en:
$n
「I won't yield to a threat like that.」

438:t_029:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's what I like to see. Before we next meet, have $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ fully completed.」

438:t_029:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Because that machine is meant for me!」

438:t_030:2.en:
$n
「To save Miss $$スズネ$$, I need to break her confidence.」

438:t_030:3.en:
$n
「And to do that, the only way is to hand her a complete defeat.」

438:t_100:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「$$マーズ$$...! I'll strike you down before you awaken to your true power!」

438:t_100:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「It must not be allowed to exist! Handled carelessly, it could even disrupt the laws of the universe!」

438:t_100:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「That doesn't mean I can just let you cut me down!」

438:t_100:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Here I come, $$ゲシュタルト$$! I'll take you down, and then I'll take down $$ズール$$!」

438:t_101:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「More, $n! Show me more of $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$'s power!」

438:t_101:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「With that power, I could even rise to the top of the $$サイデリアル$$!」

438:t_101:2.en:
$n
「This is my power to fight! It has nothing to do with you!」

438:t_101:3.en:
$n
「No... I take that back. It's also for driving you out of Miss $$スズネ$$!」

438:t_101:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Big talk! You mama's boy!」

438:t_101:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then I'll beat you down thoroughly and throw you into the abyss of despair once more!」

438:t_102:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're persistent, $n! Still not giving up!?」

438:t_102:1.en:
$n
「If you were inside Miss $$スズネ$$, you should know how stubborn I am!」

438:t_102:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So I do. I've only now realized what a nuisance you are as an enemy.」

438:t_102:4.en:
$n
「No matter what hardships await, I'll go forward as my heart tells me!」

438:t_102:5.en:
$n
「I'll overcome both the convenient hope and the despair that rots everything!!」
